sentences.text: Anglosuchus is a member of the family Pholidosauridae.
The genus was established by Mook in 1942, building on species originally described by Richard Owen in 1884, including A. geoffroyi and A. laticeps.
It was originally classified as a teleosaurid but was later reassigned to the family Pholidosauridae.
Fossils date from the Bajocian to the Bathonian stages, spanning the Aptian to the Albian, with Anglosuchus living during the Bathonian stage between 168.2 and 165.3 million years ago.
